svg.text: Seeed XIAO ESP32-C6 (ESP32-S3 pin in brackets) · LED exit sign + buzzer + 3 MQ gas channels + AHT air sensor + SOS · main repeater = IS_GATEWAY 1
3 short beeps every 1.5 s during an evacuation
FC-16 · 4 modules · exit sign / arrow + distance
use the IN side of the chain
INPUT_PULLUP · sends SOS to the hub
Divider on every MQ output: V_pin = 0.667 × V_AO (10 kΩ top, 20 kΩ to GND) — firmware × 1.5 to undo it.
MQ heaters need 5 V, ~150 mA each, 24–48 h burn-in, 60 s warm-up. Limits are set on the hub Limits tab.
Unused channels: set GAS_CHANNELS 1 or 2 and leave those pins empty. Serial 'd' = matrix test.
